About the role

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to design, build and operate the systems that our product teams depend on every day. You will own services end to end, from design reviews to production support, and work closely with security and data teams.

Responsibilities

  • Design and run reliable distributed services on Kubernetes and AWS.
  • Improve deployment pipelines, observability and incident response.
  • Mentor engineers and lead architecture reviews across teams.

Requirements

  • Seven or more years of backend or platform engineering experience.
  • Strong Python, Go or Java, and solid knowledge of cloud networking.
  • Clear written communication and a habit of documenting decisions.
